_comment: Single source for the default models. ai-provider.ts imports it and scripts/check-ai.mjs reads it, so the diagnostic can never report on a model the app does not use. Verified against the live catalogues on 2026-09-24. OpenRouter accepts at most three models per request, so the list is the primary plus two - picked from different vendors, since two models from one vendor saturate together. Override per environment with GROQ_MODEL / OPENROUTER_MODEL.
